scope: Computed prototype toward Figures 5 and 7, restricted to the outgoing CNM saddle on the plus-density branch of equation 11. Not a complete reproduction of every published region or auxiliary curve.
mass_flux_normalization: -j / [m_H * (1 cm^-3) * (1 km s^-1)]; positive means condensation. Physical j is g cm^-2 s^-1.
assumptions: Pure atomic hydrogen, gamma=5/3, kappa=2.5e3 sqrt(T), and the printed equations 5-7 heating/cooling fit.
Steady planar geometry, constant mass and momentum flux, plus-density branch of equation 11.
Temperature rises from the cold equilibrium along its outgoing saddle direction; inputs lacking this saddle are masked.
No time-dependent hydrodynamic calculation, self-gravity, magnetic field, shock continuation, or alternative density branch.
A finite sampling grid; color boundaries are not digitized comparisons with the original figures.
Near-root capture versus overshoot is tested by successive temperature-distance refinements. Unresolved cases stay separate.
The published j_crit overlay is not reproduced: its reference-temperature selection requires clarification. It is not needed for direct trajectory classification.
